scripts.build:agent: cargo zigbuild -p zenyttd --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl --target aarch64-unknown-linux-musl && cargo zigbuild --manifest-path sync-server/Cargo.toml --target-dir target --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl --target aarch64-unknown-linux-musl
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter zenytt-desktop exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter zenytt-mobile exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter zenytt-discord-bot typecheck
